card.name: Mid-sentence words in all-caps label text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verb pieces in the middle of a sentence, mostly in ALL-CAPS warning text (e.g. CAN, THAT, TO, AS, NOT). Also fires partway through author surnames in reference lists.

modes.label: All-caps sentence middle
modes.description: Linking or helper words inside an all-caps warning sentence, before the clause continues.
modes.example: BUT OTHER DRUGS KNOWN TO BE HEPATOTOXINS<< CAN>> CAUSE LIVER FAILURE RAPID

modes.label: Surnames in citations
modes.description: The middle of an author surname in a reference list.
modes.example: 1. Ronca F, Palmieri L, Panic<<ucci>> P, Ronca G. Anti-inflammatory

card.writes: It suppresses sentence-opening words like For, To, And and With, so it discourages starting a new sentence.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a running sentence, mostly in capital-letter warnings, where a new sentence should not start.
